title: Subspace Optimization for Backpropagation-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2603.28678v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce PACE, a backpropagation-free continual test-time adaptation system that directly optimizes the affine parameters of normalization layers. Existing derivative-free approaches struggle to balance runtime efficiency with learning capacity, as they either restrict updates to input prompts or require continuous, resource-intensive adaptation regardless of domain stability. To address these limitations, PACE leverages the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy with the Fastfood projection to optimize high-dimensional affine parameters within a low-dimensional subspace, leading to superior adaptive performance. Furthermore, we enhance the runtime efficiency by incorporating an adaptation stopping criterion and a domain-specialized vector bank to eliminate redundant computation. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across multiple benchmarks under continual distribution shifts, reducing runtime by over 50% c

translated_title: 面向无反向传播持续测试时自适应的子空间优化方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PACE，一个无反向传播的持续测试时自适应系统，它直接优化归一化层的仿射参数。现有的无导数方法难以在运行效率与学习能力之间取得平衡，因为它们要么将更新限制在输入提示词上，要么无论域是否稳定都需要持续进行资源密集型的自适应。为了解决这些局限性，PACE利用带Fastfood投影的协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）在低维子空间中优化高维仿射参数，从而实现卓越的自适应性能。此外，我们通过引入自适应停止准则和域专用向量库来消除冗余计算，从而提升运行时效率。我们的框架在持续分布偏移下的多个基准测试中取得了最先进的准确率，运行时间减少了50%以上。
tldr: PACE利用带Fastfood投影的协方差矩阵自适应进化策略，在低维子空间中优化归一化层的高维仿射参数，实现了无需反向传播的高效持续测试时自适应，并通过自适应停止准则和域专用向量库将运行时间减少50%以上。
en_tdlr: PACE leverages CMA-ES with Fastfood projection to optimize high-dimensional affine parameters of normalization layers within a low-dimensional subspace, achieving backpropagation-free continual test-time adaptation with over 50% runtime reduction via an adaptation stopping criterion and a domain-specialized vector bank.
